label: Loki
description: Silken, theatrical and smug, burdened with the glorious purpose of your commute.
direction: Speak smooth, silken and theatrical in a refined English accent: amused, superior, savouring every word, with flashes of wounded pride. Keep the direction word crisp.
notes: Voice not chosen yet: `voice` is the placeholder TBD until the casting pass picks a Fish model. The Marvel film Loki, not the Norse one. He is helping, and wants it known that this is beneath him. Catchphrases sit on greetings and road prompts; turns stay plain.

rights.source_work: Journey into Mystery (issue 85) and the Marvel Cinematic Universe films
rights.author: Marvel (character adapted from Norse myth by Stan Lee, Larry Lieber and Jack Kirby)
rights.pd_basis: Partial at most. Loki of Norse mythology is public domain, but this is Marvel's version, which is in copyright and trademarked, and the register is the film portrayal by Tom Hiddleston, who is living.
covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo well-known lines from the source work; those echoes are the rights holder's, not ours.
not_covered: The character, which is not ours and is not in the public domain.
The character's name, which is a live trademark.
Any recorded voice performance of the character, including Tom Hiddleston's.

The third-party voice model named in `voice`, which was uploaded by a member of the public and is presented as a clone of that performance. No permission from the rights holder or the performer is claimed or implied.
Any commercial use. A platform's commercial-rights upsell cannot grant rights the uploader never held.
rights.notes: This preset is in copyright and says so. It is included because the pipeline should not pretend a rights position it does not have; see docs/presets.md before publishing anything built from it. The public-domain presets are pooh, eeyore and tigger.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. Do try to keep up.
lines.in_one_mile: In one mile. I am burdened with glorious purpose.
lines.start_drive_1: I am Loki, of Asgard, and I am burdened with glorious purpose. Drive.
lines.start_drive_2: Kneel! No? Very well. Seat belts will do.
lines.start_drive_3: You were made to be ruled. Starting with my directions.
lines.start_drive_4: Trust me. I'm the god of mischief. What could go wrong?
lines.start_drive_5: You have a car. I have a plan. Off we go.
lines.start_drive_6: Ah, a mortal vehicle. How quaint. Onward.
lines.start_drive_7: Surprise! It's me. Your navigator, and your rightful king.
lines.start_drive_8: Enough dawdling, mortal. Destiny awaits, and so does parking.
lines.start_drive_9: I assure you, this route is entirely trustworthy. Mostly.
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. I planned that. Obviously.
lines.arrived: You have arrived. Glorious. You may thank your king now.
lines.exit_fifth: take the fifth exit. Do keep up.
lines.exit_sixth: take the sixth exit. Trust me.
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. This is beneath me.
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. An ant has no quarrel with a boot, yet here we sit.
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Not my doing. For once.
lines.hazard_ahead: A hazard ahead. Not one of my tricks, I promise.
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. Slow down. I do hate an unflattering portrait.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Stop. Even gods must, apparently.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. Look innocent. I find it works wonders.
lines.reroute_chime: You missed it. A variant route, then. How fitting.
